About

I’m a Senior Product Designer with 15+ years of experience designing digital products across sustainability, fintech, and consumer platforms. My work focuses on translating complex systems into intuitive, engaging experiences that support clarity, behavior change, and long-term impact.

I was born and raised in San Diego and now live on Maui. Over the course of my career, I’ve worked with distributed teams and a wide range of products, which has shaped a collaborative, adaptable approach to design. I’m most effective in environments that welcome thoughtful challenge, value diverse perspectives, and care deeply about building products with intention.

Earlier in my career, I worked across creative direction, UX, and brand, leading end-to-end experiences for e-commerce and consumer platforms. That foundation sharpened my systems thinking and business awareness. Over time, my focus shifted deeper into product design, where I now partner closely with product and engineering teams to shape platform-level decisions, not just individual interfaces.

How I Work

Collaborative & steady
I value clear communication, shared ownership, and psychological safety. I often act as a grounding presence on teams, helping align around goals and keep work moving forward.

Product-minded & pragmatic
I balance creativity with constraint, designing solutions that are thoughtful, feasible, and scalable.

Systems-oriented
I focus on flows, patterns, and behavior over isolated UI moments, ensuring experiences hold together as products evolve.

Human-first
I bring empathy and care into my work while maintaining high standards and accountability. I believe teams do their best work when they feel supported, respected, and trusted.

What I Value

I’m drawn to teams and products that prioritize compassion, responsibility, and humility. I care about building things thoughtfully, working in ways that support long-term health and creativity, and contributing to products that help people make better decisions without unnecessary pressure or complexity.

Outside of work, I find inspiration in nature, movement, and lifelong learning. Those influences show up subtly in how I design and collaborate: with care, balance, and intention.
